items.summary: Meta Platforms (META), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), and Apple (AAPL) are the next Big Tech names — part of the Magnificent Seven — to report quarterly earnings results this week. items.title: Lucid Is Now Up 33% in a Month, Easily Beating Tesla and Rivian. What Will It Take to Get LCID Stock Back to $10?
items.summary: A Saudi prince just bought a $129 million stake in Lucid, sparking a 25% intraday surge that left Tesla and Rivian in the dust. But with a fraud lawsuit, a looming earnings report, and a bankruptcy clock ticking, the road to $10 runs through far more than a short squeeze.
